notes.title: Wrong Landing reslease date!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Wrong Landing will be released on December 16, 2023.

We are also planning lots of updates, such as a longer story, more features and mechanics, and much more.

notes.title: Planned release moved to...
notes.notes: Hey survivors, we are announcing that the planned release of November 2023 will be postponed and moved to December 2023 or until January 2024... Thank you for your understanding and have a good time!
